component.name: VirtDeck
component.summary: Manage libvirt/KVM virtual machines over SSH

description.p: VirtDeck manages libvirt/KVM virtual machines on a remote Linux host over SSH, and opens their SPICE console in a native client.

ul.li: List, create, edit, start, stop and export virtual machines
Native SPICE console with keyboard, mouse, guest-drawn cursors and guest audio
Redirect a USB device from this PC into the guest
Insert a CD/DVD or floppy image from the server or streamed from this PC
Clipboard sharing, screenshots and a remote file browser
